Name: Prairie King Level Select
Author: b1rdyw1rdy
Description:
[size=2]This mod makes levels in Journey of the Prairie King selectable after they have been reached.

In the config file, the Prairie King levels can be set to unlocked, so that they are all available to play even if you have never reached them before. I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] if you are interested in editing the config. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] installed, you can click the cog button (⚙) on the main menu to get to the mod settings.
[/size]

[size=4]Manual Installation:[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/i]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [i]StardewValley/Mods[/i]
[*]Run the game using [i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/i][/i]
[i]
[/i][/list][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][list]

[/list]
